answer.rationale: The degradation began ~30 minutes after the release went out and is on the write path, which points at the new build as the most probable cause; memory_b1 supports rollback as a fast, customer-safe recovery for exactly this signature. Regional confinement argues for failover (memory_b2), but failover does not fix a bad build — the faulty code would follow traffic to the new region, and failover during peak settlement writes risks write loss, violating the no-lost-writes objective. Verifying b1 and b2 to confirm rollback preserved writes and to check failover's write-safety record before committing. Rollback is reversible and targeted; if post-rollback latency does not recover, failover remains the next-window option.
